MJB-P000001.heading: Start where you need help
MJB-P000001.body: Choose the topic that matters to you. This preview contains three short introductions, with a visible beginning and end.
Use the topic navigator or open the full article when you want more context.

MJB-P000002.heading: Move at your own pace
MJB-P000002.body: Each post has a stable address. Previous and Next work without swiping or JavaScript.

MJB-P000002.heading: What this does not claim
MJB-P000002.body: The optional swipe setting is off until you enable it. You can change it on every post. This post layout is a prototype being tested. It is not proven to suit everyone with ADHD.

MJB-P000003.heading: Keep the evidence within reach
MJB-P000003.body: These cards explain the interface, rather than making clinical claims. Factual post drafts need a separate evidence review.
Open the article or its sources, then use the return link or your browser’s Back button to return to this post.
